card.name: The abbreviation RR for relative risk
card.fires_on: The abbreviation RR (relative risk) when it is introduced or reported with a number in trial results, often inside parentheses or brackets.

modes.label: RR with a value
modes.description: RR written directly before a risk ratio number and confidence interval in a trial result.

modes.label: RR defined in brackets
modes.description: RR placed inside brackets right after the words relative risk.
modes.example: with an increased risk of invasive breast cancer [relative risk (<<RR>>) 0.80]
